__comment: Copy this file to <customer_id>.json and edit. Onboarding a new customer requires NO code change — only this file. Call the agent with customer_id=<your file name without .json>.
description: Human-readable name of the customer / workbook family.
__comment_sheets: Add or remove sheet roles here. match_patterns are case-insensitive substrings tested against each tab name (workbook workflow). filename_patterns are the same idea but tested against a standalone reference file's basename instead (see REFERENCE_FILES.md) — punctuation-insensitive, so 'LTP_2026_08.csv' still matches 'ltp'. To support a new sheet -> output, add a new entry and a matching block under 'targets'.
__comment_exceptions: Post-build audit (core/exceptions.py) on the FINAL NEO/LAO rows, after mapping + cross-reference enrichment. Flagged rows go to NEO_Exceptions.csv/LAO_Exceptions.csv for review; they stay in NEO.csv/LAO.csv unchanged. Keep this list short and load-bearing — every other field is legitimately blank sometimes by this project's design, and flagging those would bury real exceptions in noise.
__comment_targets: One block per output CSV. output_columns is the FIXED header/order. Each field declares source_class: customer_file (mapped by AI+scorer from a column in this workbook), enrichment (filled later by AMT/Xref/IK17 join — left blank, never invented), constant (from 'constants'), or derived (computed by a named transform in core/transforms.py).
